title: Everyday Phrases — Karaoke Night
title_quote: Are you free after work tonight?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎤 實用K歌之夜必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Karaoke Night
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用K歌之夜情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從下班後群組約人數、訂大包廂、按小時計費與付訂金、問能不能自帶飲料，到店放包拿麥克風、操作點歌系統、分配合唱與調音量回聲，到排隊等歌、處理切歌延遲與麥克風沒電、點小吃果盤，最後加時續費、帳單分攤、拿回外套、上車報平安，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Karaoke Night phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole evening: texting the group after work, booking a big room by the hour, paying the deposit and asking about outside drinks; arriving, grabbing mics, using the song-request screen and tuning echo and volume; waiting in the queue, skipping songs, dead mic batteries and ordering snacks and fruit; then extending the time, splitting the bill, collecting coats and calling a car home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you free after work tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to go karaoke with us?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me ask the group chat.
dialogue.zh: 我來問一下群組的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 十個人要訂大一點的包廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you book the large one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will call them right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 問問七點還有沒有位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven is open, I booked it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will be there by seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪ wɪl bi ðɛr baɪ ˈsɛvən./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we need a big table.
dialogue.zh: 但我們需要一張大桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not bad for a big room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們要先在線上付訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pay you back tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The deposit comes back to us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if we come on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they keep my phone number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we bring our own drinks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the rules online.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No outside drinks, but water is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd drɪŋks, bʌt ˈwɔtər ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 外面的飲料不行，但水可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sell soda in the room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have hot tea there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will hide my chips in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl haɪd maɪ tʃɪps ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我要把洋芋片藏在包包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I will post in the group.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ wɪl poʊst ɪn ðə ɡrup./
dialogue.zh: 我現在要在群組裡發訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we need a good singer.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們正缺會唱的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him to text the group.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I paid with my card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can pay me back tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a member card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I give them our names?
dialogue.zh: 我要把大家的名字給他們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lobby is on level two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, by the lobby sign.
dialogue.zh: 了解，我在大廳招牌旁等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, I will check the route.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, we booked a large room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is room two zero four.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall on your right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, it looks fun.
dialogue.zh: 就是這間，看起來好好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me put my bag down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hooks are by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, it is warm inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me try the spare one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I type the song name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, I found it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, I liked so many songs.
dialogue.zh: 你看，我標了好多喜歡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的清單已經很長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want a duet with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在麥克風聽起來好乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以把我的聲音調大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there an English song list?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe they do not have it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us sing three fast ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I need a short break.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the queue so long?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The new guy sang off key.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He does not mind at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小心點，下一個就輪到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the switch at the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the other mic is dying.
dialogue.zh: 噢，另一支麥克風也快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, the bag is empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, but I love it.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，可是我太愛這首。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的耳朵一下就要痛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not want to wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is only three minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要再延長時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, I will ask at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, aɪ wɪl æsk æt ðə dɛsk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if we can keep it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, the sign says so.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，門口牌子上就這麼寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡要付現金還是刷卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he helped us a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it is in my wallet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get your coat from the hook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time let us go earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should book the same room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, I will send a date.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing I have a coat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will text a car for Anna.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛkst ə kɑr fər ˈænə./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pickup is at the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I live near there too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I can walk from here.
dialogue.zh: 那我下車走過去就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me when you get home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 安娜傳訊息說她到家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我耳朵裡還聽得到音樂。
